title: Reports a task needs are kept in the repository
what: Every report a task's later steps or the owner need (design, its review, the code review with the owner's words, the check, the fix report, the brief) is kept in the project's repository with its change, so nothing needed is lost when the machine restarts.
why: 30 Oct: designs, reviews (with the owner's words recorded against findings), fix reports and briefs live in the session's temporary folder, which macOS clears on restart; queue items and check records point at them by name. Measured 30 Oct: this session's folder holds 1354 report files (15 MB with briefs); all sessions' temporary folders for relay take 1.1 GB. A manual copy was made to the relay backup folder the same day. IP chosen by the front (agent-chosen).

said: и после перезагрузки пропадёт - это очень печально, я не перезапускал свой ноутбук уже порядка недели, не хочу терять прогресс, вероятно надо быть готовым к первому такому случаю, я не хочу терять важные отчеты для выполнения задач, более того - я хочу хранить их в репозитории

fact: 30 Oct, front decision (owner can reverse; follows from the owner's words "я хочу хранить их в репозитории" and principle 2): build the reviewed design revision 2 (approach A2): agents write reports to an ignored folder .relay/work/<branch without wt/>/ in the main checkout (survives a restart); after a successful landing the reports go into .relay/reports/<key>/ in the same commit as the change records; everything except copies and logs (about +1.4 MiB a week, measured from last week's reports); a code review file is kept when one of its findings is in no check record (23 of 569 findings last week). A one-time copy of this session's reports was made to the relay backup folder on 30 Oct. Agent cost 2-2.5 h, a guess.

question: Are a change's working reports kept in the repository after it lands, or only its plan (design) and design review?
options: a. plans and their reviews only, next to the queue item (recommended: no code reads change reports after landing; check records already hold 546 of 569 review findings)
b. also briefs, build and fix reports (about +0.4 MiB a week, about 60 agent minutes more to build; a guess)
